banking-economy.title: PNB to hold off on subsidiary monetisation, focus on value creation: MD Ashok Chandra
banking-economy.summary: Punjab National Bank will not monetize subsidiaries soon, focusing on operational strengthening for future value. The bank's capital adequacy exceeds 18 percent, well above regulatory requirements. This strong capitalization means no market fund raising is planned for growth initiatives. PNB expects its net profit to surpass twenty thousand crore rupees this financial year. Loan growth is projected at twelve to thirteen percent while deposits will grow nine to ten percent.
